adapters.doc: The machine's own relay, built in: `local-loopback` serves every exposed port to this machine alone, `local-every-interface` serves public ports to any machine that reaches it. Where each listens is never a setting.

settings_schema.title: LocalRelayInstanceSettings
settings_schema.description: A local relay instance's settings. Its bind address is never one.

port.description: The port the listener takes for QUIC and HTTP alike; absent, the listener's own default (4443 at loopback, 4445 at every interface).

adapters.doc: A relay Cloudflare provisioned, dialed at its publish-and-subscribe URL, which carries its token and is kept whole as a secret. Serves public ports, at the relay's top level.

relay_url.description: The relay's publish-and-subscribe URL as Cloudflare returns it, `https://draft-16.cloudflare.mediaoverquic.com/<token>`; its token rides the path, so the whole URL is a secret.

adapters.doc: A moq.pro project, dialed at its path on moq.pro's relays with a token signed by the project's key, which is kept as a secret. Serves public ports, under the project.

project_id.description: The project's id as moq.pro names it: the root every token is minted under and the path the relay is dialed at.

relay_url.description: The relays the project is served at; absent, `https://cdn.moq.dev`.

signing_key.description: The project's signing key, the JWK moq.pro gave for it, as JSON or base64url JSON. It mints read and write for every broadcast of the project.

adapters.doc: A test build's relay whose settings hold a secret; it joins nothing.

token.description: The secret the tests look for everywhere it must not be.
